newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Jianshe to issue 96 dividend.
newsitem.headline: China's Jianshe to issue 96 dividend.

text.p: Shenzhen North Jianshe Motorcycle Co Ltd will make a pre-tax cash payment of 0.069 yuan per share as dividend for 1996, a company statement said on Wednesday.

Holders of the company's hard currency B shares would receive the dividend in Hong Kong dollars at an exchange rate of HK$1 to 1.0701 yuan, said the statement published in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times.
The dividend issue had been approved by the firm's shareholders and local securities regulators, it said.
The registration deadline for B shares was set for July 31 and the shares would go ex-dividend following day, it said.
North Jianshe's net profits plunged to 50.73 million yuan in 1996 from 288.71 million yuan in 1995 based on international accounting standards.
